title: Control-plane: goal_reconcile PR type and DAG-based goal-complete
outcome: A multi-task goal can complete one task without forcing goal-complete, and a goal's frozen-plan tasks can be registered into main state through a narrow, frozen-plan-bound goal_reconcile PR type — resolving the per-task-scope x dependency-done x goal-complete deadlock without weakening per-task scope.
completion_conditions: validate goal-complete uses the frozen DAG node set
goal_reconcile metadata mode is deny-by-default and frozen-plan-bound
pre-PR adversarial review of the scope relaxation finds 0 confirmed defects
non_goals: No change to normal task PR per-task scope
No manual admin bypass of the deadlock
